At every legal prefix length t, the current payoff is at least c/n+(U-c)/D_t, D_t=max(t+s(n-t)/2,n+s-1); root W>=c+Gamma_(n,s)(U-c), Gamma=sum_t 1/D_t. The full-union bound depends on s and does not solve unrestricted half coverage.
